newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp cautions Wall St on shr buybacks.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp cautions Wall St on shr buybacks.

text.p: Citicorp principal financial officer Thomas Jones told analysts and investors some of their assumptions on share repurchases for 1997 may be too aggressive.
Jones spoke to a late afternoon meeting after Citicorp released fourth-quarter earnings early in the day. Reporters were also in attendance.
Jones did not give any figures on future share repurchases.
Citicorp has bought back nearly 60 million shares over 1995 and 1996, including 8.1 million in 1996 fourth quarter.

Jones referred to a slide showing the average price paid in the share repurchases was $66 in 1995 and $85 in 1996. In the fourth quarter the average price paid per share was $101. Citicorp shares have been rising since the early 1990's.
The company has had a policy of using free capital not needed for dividends or for investment to repurchase shares. Jones said nothing to indicate the policy has changed.
